WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-123.076491 45.221228)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1900 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-123.076491 45.221228)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
high_elevation_raster AS (
  SELECT rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-123.076491 45.221228)'), 4326), 3857), 100000),
    rast
  )
),
elevation_cells AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Union(rast), 1)).*
  FROM high_elevation_raster
),
filtered_cells AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM elevation_cells
  WHERE val > 1900
),
nearest_cell AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(p.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_Centroid((val).geom), 4326)::geography) AS distance_meters
  FROM park_geom p,
  LATERAL (
    SELECT (vals).*
    FROM (
      SELECT unnest(array_agg((vals).* ORDER BY ST_Distance(ST_SetSRID(ST_Centroid((vals).geom), 4326)::geography, p.geom))) AS vals
      FROM filtered_cells
    ) sub
    LIMIT 1
  ) nearest
)
SELECT MIN(distance_meters) AS distance_meters
FROM nearest_cell;
